findings.governingReading: His consciousness is on the verge of disappearing and his hand falls—or should have fallen—before the rescue; he does not finally pass out until after gripping Kiritsugu's hand.
findings.explanation: Shirou's consciousness beginning to fade becomes complete loss of consciousness before Kiritsugu catches his hand.

findings.highlight: He actually looked envious of me, who was on the brink of death...he even looked grateful
findings.evidenceJa: 死の直前にいる自分が羨ましく思えるほど、男は何かに感謝するように
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu's grateful happiness is so striking that even the dying Shirou can envy him.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the envy. Shirou envies his rescuer's extraordinary happiness; the translation makes the rescuer appear envious of Shirou.

findings.highlight: I tried to become the same thing.
findings.evidenceJa: その幻影を被ろうとした
findings.governingReading: Unable to forget Kiritsugu's face, Shirou tries to put on its phantom or image as an adopted identity.
findings.explanation: Shirou trying to wear Kiritsugu's remembered image becomes trying to become ‘the same thing.’

findings.highlight: Somewhere in the back of my mind, I dreamed I wouldn't notice.
findings.evidenceJa: 心の何処かで、気づかないようにと夢見ていたんだ
findings.governingReading: Somewhere within himself, he harbored a dream while avoiding awareness of it: smiling like Kiritsugu might bring him relief too.
findings.explanation: Shirou's reluctance to recognize his own hope becomes a dream of not noticing something. The next page preserves his wish for relief, but its concealed place in his motives is obscured.

findings.highlight: It looks like I've been sleeping on the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 床に寝かされているらしく
findings.governingReading: On waking, Shirou infers from his position that others placed him on the floor for treatment or rest.
findings.explanation: Apparently having been laid down on the living-room floor becomes having been sleeping there.

findings.evidenceJa: 夜の十時を回っていた
findings.governingReading: The clock has already passed ten p.m.
findings.explanation: A time after ten at night becomes exactly ten.

findings.highlight: I think all your external injuries have healed up
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず外傷は塞がってるけど
findings.governingReading: The openings are sealed, but she explicitly does not know the internal condition and asks about abnormalities.
findings.explanation: Rin's observation that the external wounds have closed becomes her belief that all external injuries have healed.

findings.highlight: most will only have to spend two or three days at the hospital
findings.evidenceJa: みんな栄養失調って事で、二、三日病院で休む程度
findings.governingReading: Rin groups the affected students under the malnutrition explanation and says the extent is two or three days in the hospital.
findings.explanation: The report that the hospitalized students will rest for two or three days becomes a claim that only ‘most’ will do so.

findings.highlight: The way you heal your wounds is nearly miraculous
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず傷を塞ぐだけなら超がつくほどの回復力
findings.governingReading: Rin carefully limits the observed power: when it comes to sealing injuries for the moment, his recovery is extraordinary.
findings.explanation: Exceptional ability merely to close wounds becomes nearly miraculous healing of wounds generally.

findings.highlight: It's like my body isn't my own.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の体が、自分の知らない物になってるようなもの
findings.governingReading: His revulsion comes from an unexplained transformation into something outside his knowledge.
findings.explanation: Shirou's body becoming an unknown thing becomes his body no longer being his own.

findings.highlight: Saber comes at me with all the rage and force of a hurricane.
findings.evidenceJa: があー、と食ってかかってくるセイバー
findings.governingReading: She comes at Shirou with a written-out ‘gaa’ and confrontational energy, a comic physical rendering of exposed anger.
findings.explanation: Saber's comic growling advance gains a hurricane simile.

findings.highlight: As you can see, I've healed.
findings.evidenceJa: 体の方はこの通り大丈夫
findings.governingReading: He reassures Saber by pointing to his current condition despite persistent pain and severe unrepaired internal damage.
findings.explanation: Shirou saying his body is presently all right becomes the categorical claim that he has healed.

findings.highlight: I'm finally able to look her in the eye
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで目を合わせる事も照れくさかった相手
findings.governingReading: He can now naturally face and look straight at the person whose eyes he previously felt too shy to meet.
findings.explanation: Shirou's prior embarrassment even at meeting Saber's eyes disappears from the intimacy beat.

findings.highlight: You are too stubborn to change, aren't you?
findings.evidenceJa: その頑なさは、実に貴方らしい
findings.governingReading: Her sigh yields into affectionate or resigned recognition of a trait that is very much his own.
findings.explanation: Saber's recognition that Shirou's obstinacy is truly characteristic of him becomes criticism that he is too stubborn to change.

findings.highlight: Our handshake forms something almost tangible.
findings.governingReading: Their clasp has a certain physical sensation, and after several days they finally exchange what Shirou calls a true contract of mutual trust.
findings.explanation: A definite tactile bond and the exchange of a true contract become something ‘almost tangible’ and a contract they merely feel they formed.

findings.highlight: making sure Master is in good health before checking his pulse
findings.evidenceJa: マスターの体が健康かどうか、脈を計っていただけ
findings.governingReading: Caught holding hands, she awkwardly claims the hand contact itself was merely pulse-taking to determine whether her Master was healthy.
findings.explanation: Saber's lie that she was holding Shirou's hand to check his pulse becomes ensuring his health before checking it.

findings.highlight: Forced summoning or not, changing into your armor will shred your clothes to bits.
findings.evidenceJa: いくら強制召喚だからって、力ずくで武装したら服なんて消し飛ぶ
findings.governingReading: Rin attributes the destruction to Saber's use of brute force to materialize her armament under the exceptional sudden summon.
findings.explanation: Clothes being blown away when Saber forcefully arms herself during a forced summon becomes clothes always being shredded by changing into armor.

findings.highlight: It had been such a nice conversation until now too, but I don't really know what to do with myself
findings.evidenceJa: せっかく真面目な話をしていたのに、そんな話をされたら気が抜けて仕方がない
findings.governingReading: Shirou complains that the feminine topic makes it impossible to maintain the tension after an earnest exchange.
findings.explanation: The serious conversation being deflated by girl talk becomes a merely ‘nice’ conversation followed by Shirou not knowing what to do with himself.

findings.highlight: I fell three stories, so I'm all broken and bruised.
findings.evidenceJa: 三階から落下した体は罅と歪みだらけだ
findings.governingReading: The body, glossed as bones, is riddled with fissures and warping despite the return of consciousness and sealed wounds.
findings.explanation: Bones full of cracks and distortions after the fall become a body that is ‘broken and bruised.’
